caption: The drawing contains five distinct objects related to a pocket watch. At the top center, there is a decorative yellow and gold-colored case cover with an intricate embossed pattern featuring ornate scrollwork and detailed lines. Below the cover, on the left, there is a round, yellow-edged pocket watch face displaying black numerals (1 to 12), with black hour, minute, and second hands, and a small seconds subdial above the 6. To its right, there is a simple outline drawing showing the front and side shapes of a pocket watch, labeled "FRONT & SIDE: Exact Size." On the far right below the case cover, there is a detailed illustration of a pocket watch movement, featuring metallic silver, gold, and gray components, marked with the text "TREMONT WATCH CO. BOSTON" and the number "19692." The composition is on a plain, light beige background, and the objects are evenly spaced.
title: Watch, Face and Case
